answer: Agents streaming a fable to terrace and lagoon kiosks could face this rule: each ID/day burns 1 token and submits an ID/day-bound kiosk-signed playback receipt. Validators verify ledger burns, signatures and bindings, rejecting reuse; failure denies listing. Ten IDs burn 10 tokens/day despite shared servers or parallel streams. Fees recur and are spent, not locked stake; servers are reusable capital. Kiosk collusion can fake delivery, not burns under honest consensus. Cheap tokens weaken deterrence; this prices access, not unique owners.
